title: Nullified Eggs
description: Backports post-1.21.5 egg textures to 1.21.4, w/ mod support
body: This can be used in vanilla Minecraft. This pack adds spawn eggs for YDM's Red Panda and backports spawn eggs for the mod Friends&Foes, and uses the new vanilla Copper Golem spawn egg in place of the regular Friends&Foes texture.
